## Python

### Answer 1 - Brute Force

```{python}
#| cache: true
#| label: py-brute-force

import time

def collatz_long(x: int) -> int:
  m = 0
  for n in range(int(x)-1, 0, -1):
    j = 1
    n0 = n
    while n > 1:
      if n % 2 == 0: n/=2
      else: n = 3*n+1
      j += 1
    if j > m:
      m = j
      i = n0
  return({'n': i, 'length': m})

t0 = time.perf_counter()
print(collatz_long(x=1e6))
t1 = time.perf_counter()
t = t1 - t0
print(f'{t:.3f} sec elapsed')
```
